name: B站搜索
description: 在B站搜索关键词，返回指定条数视频结果（标题/作者/链接，默认 10，最多 100；不足时自动翻页）。

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: 返回视频条数（默认 10，最多 100）

inputs.name: maxPages
inputs.description: 最多翻页数（默认 3，上限 5；仅当结果不足 limit 时才翻页）

body.name: open_tab
body.note: 直接打开B站搜索结果页（比首页输入框更稳，不受首页改版影响）

body.name: waitForSelector
body.note: 等待结果卡片渲染完成

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const keyword=want('$query');const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||10,100));const maxP=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$maxPages'))||3,5));const isCover=(t)=>/^稍后再看/.test(t)||/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(t);const extract=(root)=>{const out=[];const seen=new Set();for(const c of root.querySelectorAll('.bili-video-card')){const links=[...c.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/video/BV']")];if(!links.length)continue;let href=links[0].getAttribute('href')||'';let url=href.startsWith('//')?('https:'+href):href;try{url=new URL(url,location.href).href;}catch{}if(seen.has(url))continue;const titEl=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--tit');let title=titEl?(titEl.textContent||'').trim():'';if(!title){const t=links.map(x=>(x.textContent||'').trim()).find(x=>x.length>2&&!isCover(x));title=t||'';}if(!title||title.length<2)continue;seen.add(url);const owner=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--owner');const author=owner?(owner.textContent||'').split('·')[0].trim().slice(0,40):'';out.push({title:title.slice(0,150),url:url,author:author});}return out;};const start=Date.now();let links=[];while(Date.now()-start<12000){links=extract(document);if(links.length>=3)break;await sleep(400);}let pages=1;const base='https://search.bilibili.com/all?keyword='+encodeURIComponent(keyword||'');while(links.length<lim&&pages<maxP){const next=base+'&page='+(pages+1);await sleep(1400+Math.floor(Math.random()*800));let html=null;try{const r=await fetch(next,{credentials:'include'});if(!r.ok)break;html=await r.text();}catch{break;}if(!html||html.length<500)break;let doc=null;try{doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');}catch{break;}const seen=new Set(links.map(x=>x.url));const added=extract(doc);let grew=0;for(const it of added){if(links.length>=lim)break;if(!seen.has(it.url)){links.push(it);grew++;}}pages++;if(!grew)break;}return {count:links.length,links:links.slice(0,lim),pages:pages,text:(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,6000).trim()};})()

body.note: 卡片级抓取：标题优先 .bili-video-card__info--tit，兜底滤掉封面文本（稍后再看/播放量+弹幕+时长粘连）
